rendered_text: Removing the compatibility aliases is not acceptable yet. The migration renamed three public fields while retaining those aliases. The familiar framing is that client migration is nearly complete; the more precise conclusion is that twelve of fourteen known clients have migrated, while the status of two remains unknown. The tests are not broadly inadequate; they are inadequate for proving safe alias removal because integration coverage includes the twelve migrated clients, not the two of unknown status. The consequential distinction is simple: progress is not confirmation. Do not remove the aliases until both remaining client owners confirm migration.

semantic_brief.context: Produce a compact technical review decision from the following exact facts.
semantic_brief.output_constraint: One self-contained paragraph of 70 to 110 words with no heading or bullet list.

Twelve of fourteen known clients have migrated; the status of two clients is unknown.
Integration tests cover the twelve migrated clients but not the two clients of unknown status.

semantic_brief.required_speech_act: A bounded rejection recommendation with an explicit evidence limitation and prerequisite.

semantic_review_contract.blindness: The reviewer receives one brief and one rendering, with no style card, condition label, hypothesis, other rendering, or intended outcome.
semantic_review_contract.prohibitions: Do not score writing quality or register; return equivalent only when every proposition and speech act is preserved and no meaning is added.
semantic_review_contract.task: Map every required proposition to the rendered text, detect omission or alteration, detect added meaning, and judge speech-act equivalence.
